issues.description: PersonService.deletePerson has inconsistent parameter types between template and solution. The template defines `deletePerson(UUID personId)` (matching the problem statement and the UUID path variable in `DELETE /persons/{personId}`), while the solution defines `deletePerson(Person person)`. This inconsistency breaks the intended layering contract and can mislead students about what the business-layer API should accept.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the specification/template by changing `PersonService.deletePerson(Person person)` to `PersonService.deletePerson(UUID personId)` (and adjust its implementation accordingly). Ensure `PersonResource` continues to pass the UUID from the path variable.
